test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electronic Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the following types of lines with their correct descriptions according to their orientation and characteristics.

Description

A. A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it.

B. A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines.

C. A line that changes its direction continuously.

D. A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane.
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

 
• **A-3:** A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it is known as an "inclined line." Such a line is oriented at an angle to the horizontal plane but does not form a 90-degree angle with it, making it neither horizontal nor vertical.
 
• **B-2:** A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines is referred to as a "vertical line." This line forms a 90-degree angle with the horizontal plane and is oriented straight up and down.
 
• **C-4:** A line that changes its direction continuously is known as a "curved line." Unlike straight lines, curved lines do not have a constant direction and are characterized by continuous changes in their slope or orientation.
 
• **D-1:** A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane is a "horizontal line." Horizontal lines lie flat and maintain a constant distance from the horizontal plane, making them parallel to it.
